summary: Figure 3 main-figure layout rebuilt as 3x2 (composition, O+ zoom, 4 per-class grand-average trace panels), per explicit spec review with the user before implementation. Presence/peak-rate/UMAP demoted to supplement.

claims.text: New panel B: O+-only zoom of panel A's composition (same denominator, legacy-screened units), exact binomial CI per area.
claims.receipt: context/figures/fig03_unit_census/svg/fig03_B_composition_oplus_zoom.png -- values 1.6-3.3%, matches user's stated expectation of ~0-2%.

claims.text: New panels C/D/E/F: grand average +- SEM trace, full trial, one functional class each (S+/S++, S-/S--, O+, O++), all 4 R-family conditions overlaid per panel.
claims.receipt: context/figures/fig03_unit_census/svg/fig03_{C,D,E,F}_grand_avg_*.png, visually verified via browser render: C and D show clean condition-specific omission-flat/no-suppression patterns; E (O+, n=70) shows the expected condition-specific omission-evoked bump; F (O++, n=3) is uninterpretable noise, stated plainly in README.

claims.text: UMAP embedding does NOT meet the user's stated bar for staying in the main figure (O+/O++ clustered together, S+/S++ together, S-/S-- together, Other surrounding) -- checked directly against the rendered panel.
claims.receipt: context/figures/fig03_unit_census/svg/fig03_supp_class_embedding.png -- O+ (magenta) scattered with no distinct cluster, Other (gray) intermixed rather than surrounding; S++/S-- occupy loosely separated regions but that alone doesn't meet the stated bar. Moved to supplement per the stated conditional.

claims.text: Presence/stability panel and peak-rate panel moved to supplement alongside UMAP, per explicit direction.
claims.receipt: context/figures/fig03_unit_census/svg/fig03_supp_presence_peakrate_umap.svg (assembled), fig03.svg reassembled to 468x502pt, 3x2 grid, main figure only contains A/B/C/D/E/F.

notes: Two real bugs found and fixed while building this: (1) main() referenced ns8/n_no_rxrr variables from the removed single-RXRR template-trace call after the multi-condition refactor -- fixed by computing ns8 directly from d8.class8_trace.value_counts() and renaming n_no_rxrr -> n_no_trials_grand throughout. (2) none found in the new panel code itself; smoke-tested by full run before reporting done.

Score not changed in REVISION_PLAN.md/README.md/FIGURE_SUMMARY.md by this turn -- scores are user-assigned per that plan's own stated convention, not derived. User should reassess fig03's 80/100 given this redesign is now complete.
